title: Devices and server: clock ping, state snapshot, shown report
description: PROVISIONAL. Derived from the message catalogue (clock ping, state snapshot) and the synchronized display rules (devices report when they displayed a message). Finalize in step 2.

serverReceivedAt.description: Optional. When the ping reached the server; serverTime is when the pong left it. With both, the device takes the server's processing time out of the round trip (NTP): offset = ((serverReceivedAt - clientSentAt) + (serverTime - clientReceivedAt)) / 2, round trip = (clientReceivedAt - clientSentAt) - (serverTime - serverReceivedAt). Without it, the device assumes serverTime was read half a round trip after sending.

serverTime.description: When the pong left the server.

clockPong.description: Server to device: the answer to a clock ping. Accepted 2026-10-26 (spec-feedback item 18): serverReceivedAt added.

stateSnapshot.description: Sent to a device on connect and on resync: current state and phase, banners, recent relevant messages (on resync: the ones after the device's cursor), own target if sorting.

cursor.description: A reconnecting client sends its cursor and receives only what it missed.

banners.description: The sticky messages the device shows now, in display order: the first is the main banner. A driver can have a race-wide state and their own penalty at the same time.

shownReport.description: A device reports when it displayed a message. Feeds the lateness statistics.

shownAt.description: Device time corrected by its measured offset.

late.description: True if the message arrived after its showAt time.

receivedAt.description: When the message arrived on the device, device time corrected by its measured offset.

offsetMs.description: The device's current offset estimate: server clock minus device clock, in milliseconds.

rttMs.description: Round trip of the ping sample the offset came from. The offset is accurate to about half of it, which bounds how exact shownAt is.
